independence_and_allowed_inputs.statement: Fresh independent source-only review. Only the supplied focused current objects, supplied all172 projection, two supplied manifests, full original CORE extraction and full specified official FAQ text snapshots were consulted. No summary/candidate, reader answer or prompt/output, grade, prior adjudication, coverage/source-audit report, repair history, other-agent output/runtime or canonical bank body was read. Embedded artifact provenance was not followed. No browsing, delegation, git mutation or rescoring was performed.
independence_and_allowed_inputs.source_authority: CORE is the original core procedure authority; applicable official living FAQ clarifications/errata are applied. Later-product examples in these FAQ files do not establish an original-core producer.
independence_and_allowed_inputs.scope: Original 2017 core, balanced boards, normal Blight, one-Spirit solo and stated introductory alternatives. Expansion/promo procedures, adversaries/scenarios, thematic maps and optional difficulty/scoring excluded as tested procedures.

questions.literal_question: In a two-Spirit game with 7 of 8 Fear markers already generated, an effect generates 3 Fear and earning a card exposes Terror II. Explain marker handling, new Terror timing, and when the card is revealed/resolved.

fixed_key_review.entire_answer_reviewed: Move the eighth marker to earn the top Fear card face-down, reset all 8 to the pool and put the remaining 2 generated Fear toward the next card. Terror II applies as soon as exposed (subject to outcome check at action-tree end). Keep card hidden until Fear step, resolving in earned order at the then-current Terror level only.

fixed_key_review.entire_answer_reviewed: Destroy one Presence each of A and B, putting destroyed disks beside the island, not on tracks. questions.literal_question: How do Damage, Destroy, Remove and Replace differ for Fear and survival? Can Damage from separate normal Powers combine, does Damage normally hurt Dahan, and does replacement erase prior Damage?

fixed_key_review.entire_answer_reviewed: Damage normally means to Invaders only, distributed as chosen in target land; can combine within turn, immediately destroying pieces at Damage >= Health. Destroying Town/City produces 1/2 Fear in addition to explicit Fear. Remove/Replace generate none automatically; Replace retains prior Damage and may cause destruction if Damage meets new Health (then destruction Fear applies). Surviving Damage clears at Time Passes. Dahan are harmed by Powers only if explicitly stated. An outright Destroy instruction eliminates its specified piece regardless of its Damage or Health. Remove likewise takes the specified piece off the board without requiring Damage to reach Health. Replace removes the original and puts the specified replacement in its place.
